Sub LastRow()
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = Cells(Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    MsgBox lastRow
End Sub

Sub HighlightBig()
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In Range("C2:C100")
        If c.Value > 1000 Then c.Interior.Color = vbYellow
    Next c
End Sub

Sub FormatHeader()
    With Range("A1:E1")
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(27, 107, 63)
        .Font.Color = vbWhite
    End With
End Sub

Function Square(x As Double) As Double
    Square = x * x
End Function

Sub SumArray()
    Dim arr As Variant, i As Long, total As Double
    arr = Range("C2:C100").Value
    For i = 1 To UBound(arr, 1)
        total = total + arr(i, 1)
    Next i
    Debug.Print total
End Sub

Sub CountUnique()
    Dim d As Object, c As Range
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each c In Range("B2:B100")
        d(c.Value) = 1
    Next c
    MsgBox d.Count
End Sub

Sub AddSheets()
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 3
        Worksheets.Add(After:=Worksheets(Worksheets.Count)).Name = "Case" & i
    Next i
End Sub

Sub FastMode()
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    ' ... your code ...
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

Sub RevenueLoop()
    Dim r As Long
    r = 2
    Do While Cells(r, 1).Value <> ""
        Cells(r, 6).Value = Cells(r, 3).Value * Cells(r, 5).Value
        r = r + 1
    Loop
End Sub

Sub WriteSquares()
    Dim out(1 To 10, 1 To 1) As Long, i As Long
    For i = 1 To 10
        out(i, 1) = i ^ 2
    Next i
    Range("H1:H10").Value = out
End Sub

Sub PasteAsValues()
    Range("A1").CurrentRegion.Copy
    Range("H1").PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
End Sub
